failure_reason: Category/listing pages are blocked by Akamai Bot Manager at all 3 access tiers (403 direct HTTP; unresolved behavioral-sensor interstitial in Playwright headless and headed+mouse-simulation; same interstitial hangs in Claude-in-Chrome). Only the homepage's embedded navigation JSON (tier-a HTTP) was accessible, so the full category/subcategory tree and URLs were recovered but no on-page qty could be read for any leaf.
notes: ACCESS: tier(a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome/safari/edge browser impersonation) succeeded for the homepage (200) and yielded the complete category tree via the embedded primaryNavigation JSON in the SiteHeaderContainer React-hydration payload. Every category/listing page tested (e.g. /bed-and-bath/duvet-covers-and-duvet-inserts/1) returned 403 Access Denied (Akamai) across 5 TLS impersonation profiles (chrome131/124/120, safari17_0, edge101) with realistic headers/referer/session cookies. Escalated to tier(b) Playwright: headless launch got the same 403; headed launch with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled got HTTP 200 but rendered an Akamai 'sec-if-cpt-container' behavioral-sensor challenge interstitial that never resolved, even after simulating 20 rounds of human-like mouse movement/scroll over ~15s (which then reverted to a direct 403). Escalated to tier(c) Claude-in-Chrome (user's real logged-in Chrome via CDP): robots.txt has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/GPTBot disallow so tier(c) was permitted; navigating to the same category URL in the real browser produced the identical Akamai interstitial and the page never reached document_idle (get_page_text and screenshot both timed out after repeated waits). Block confirmed across all 3 tiers specifically for category/listing pages; the homepage and /site-index load fine at every tier. TREE: built entirely from the primaryNavigation JSON on the homepage (tier a, verified 200), cross-checked against /site-index (top-level sections only, no subcategory detail, consistent with the nav). QTY: could not be obtained for any leaf since every listing page is blocked at all tiers; all qty=null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag. h1/canonical could not be confirmed for the same reason - node names/URLs are taken verbatim from the site's own nav JSON, not invented. EXCLUDED: the Furniture nav's 'Storage & Modular Furniture' / 'Office Storage & Shelving' / 'Entryway Chests & Cabinets' items (URL path is /furniture/... - the site's own Furniture categorization; Furniture.xlsx already covers these, not touched here); all dinnerware/drinkware/serveware/cookware/appliances (Kitchen & Dining scope); all Lighting; all Wall Art/Frames/Mirrors/Vases/Sculptures/Candles/Botanicals/Planters (Wall Decor / Decorative Accessories scope); all hardware (curtain rods/rails/hooks, cabinet pulls/knobs, towel bars/rings, bath faucets, toilet paper holders); Rug Pads (functional underlay, not a textile/decor product itself); Wine Tools & Storage (tools-primary, ambiguous); Bath Accessories, Wastebaskets, Bathroom Cleaning (not genuine storage); Coat Racks & Wall Hooks, Luggage & Travel Bags (not genuine home storage per storage.md boundary); Kitchen Standing Mats (anti-fatigue mat, not textile); all /1/filters/... and ?availability=... query-filter URLs; all View All/Collections/Bestsellers/Clearance/New-Arrivals/Buying-Guide landing pages (rule 27/35). Duplicate URLs deduped to one record each: 'Outdoor Rugs' (=Indoor-Outdoor Rugs), 'Performance Rugs' (listed twice in nav), 'Laundry Hampers & Accessories' (=Laundry & Hampers under Bedding's Cleaning & Laundry group), 'Patio Furniture Covers' (listed under two Outdoor subsections), 'Pillows'/'Rugs'/'Door Mats' repeated again under Outdoor Decor.
